catalogDisagreements.verifiedToday: The operative deadline is EARLIER than the catalog shows and there is a hard prerequisite the catalog omits. From the 2026 Prescriptive Rebate Application PDF on peoplesgasdelivery.com, downloaded today: 'All final application and supporting documentation should be turned into the program by December 8, 2026' - not December 31. And: 'In 2026, ALL prescriptive projects must receive pre-approval from the program BEFORE project installation begins or equipment is purchased.' A business that installs first and applies later gets nothing. Also new: 'some measures may have a limited number of approvals in 2026, even if funding is available for other measures,' and completed applications must be received within 30 days of installation. Dollar amounts are now captured (steam traps $100-$300 each, pipe insulation $1.20-$12/linear foot, boilers $1.20-$1.50/MBH input, tune-ups $0.30/MBH up to $2,000-$3,000). Customer split is <400,000 therms/yr (Small and Midsize Business) vs >=400,000 therms/yr (Commercial and Industrial).
